description: Implement complete Eurocode-compliant calculation engine: new types, eurocode helper functions, load combinations, frame analysis, stability checks, and deflection verification (SGU). This replaces the simplified calculations in src/utils/calculations.ts with a full PN-EN 1990/1991/1993 implementation.
steps: 1. Update src/types/index.ts: Add TerrainCategory (1|2|3|4), SnowExposure ('windy'|'normal'|'sheltered'), new fields to HallParameters (terrainCategory, snowExposure), add i_y (radius of gyration cm) to SteelProfile interface, extend CalculationResults with: utilizationRatio (number), governingCombination (string), governingCondition (string), steelMassPerM2 (number), columnDeflection (number), columnDeflectionLimit (number), rafterDeflection (number), rafterDeflectionLimit (number), deflectionCheck (boolean), stabilityCheck (boolean).

2. Update src/data/profiles.ts: Add i_y values to all IPE profiles per the user specification (IPE 160: 6.58, IPE 180: 7.42, IPE 200: 8.26, IPE 220: 9.11, IPE 240: 9.97, IPE 270: 11.23, IPE 300: 12.46, IPE 330: 13.71, IPE 360: 14.95, IPE 400: 16.55, IPE 450: 18.48, IPE 500: 20.43, IPE 550: 22.35, IPE 600: 24.28). Also add i_y for IPE 80/100/120/140 (use standard values: 3.24, 4.07, 4.90, 5.74). Add i_min for trussChordProfiles (for RHS: i_min = sqrt(I/A)). Verify I values match the user spec exactly for IPE 160-600.

3. Update src/data/loads.ts: Change windZoneLoads to use correct base velocities (zone 1: vb=22, zone 2: vb=26, zone 3: vb=30) and compute qk = 0.5*1.25*vb^2/1000 (zone 1: 0.3025 -> round to 0.303, zone 2: 0.4225 -> 0.423, zone 3: 0.5625 -> 0.563). Keep snowZoneLoads unchanged (they are Sk characteristic values).

4. Create src/utils/eurocode.ts with all Eurocode helper functions: (a) Snow load: computeSnowShapeFactor(alpha) implementing mu per PN-EN 1991-1-3, computeSnowLoad(Sk, alpha, Ce, Ct=1.0) returning s in kN/m2. (b) Wind: computeBaseWindPressure(vb) = 0.5*1.25*vb^2/1000, getBaseWindVelocity(zone) returning vb, computeExposureFactor(h, terrainCategory) using table/formula with zo values [0.003, 0.05, 0.3, 1.0] and formula cr=kr*ln(h/zo), ce=(1+7*Iv)*cr^2 simplified to lookup table for h=4-10m, getCpeWallWindward()=0.8, getCpeWallLeeward()=-0.5, getCpeRoofWindward(alpha) with interpolation for 5-30 degrees, getCpeRoofLeeward()=-0.5. (c) Load combinations per PN-EN 1990: computeLoadCombinations returning array of {name, M_column, N_column, V_column} for KOMB1 (snow dominant), KOMB2 (wind dominant), KOMB3 (wind uplift). (d) Frame analysis: computeFrameMoment(q_horizontal, H, k_ramy) where k_ramy default 0.6, computing M_head = q*H^2/2 * k_ramy. (e) Stability: computeBucklingFactor(Lcr_m, i_y_cm, fy, alpha_imp=0.34) computing lambda_bar, Phi, chi_y. computeLTBFactor() returning 0.9 as safe approximation. computeInteractionCheck(NEd, MEd, A, Wpl, fy, chi_y, chi_LT, kyy=1.0, gammaM1=1.0) returning utilization ratio. (f) Deflection SGU: computeColumnDeflection(q_kN_per_m, H_m, E, I_cm4), computeRafterDeflection(q_kN_per_m, L_m, E, I_cm4). (g) Truss chord buckling: computeTrussChordBuckling(NEd, A, i_min, Lcr, fy, alpha_imp=0.49) returning utilization.

5. Rewrite src/utils/calculations.ts: Replace the entire file. The new calculateHallStructure(params) function must: (a) Compute snow load using eurocode helpers with params.snowExposure mapped to Ce (windy=0.8, normal=1.0, sheltered=1.2). (b) Compute wind loads using params.terrainCategory and params.windZone. (c) Compute linear loads on frame (snow, wind wall, wind roof) using columnSpacing as tributary width. (d) Run all 3 load combinations (KOMB1, KOMB2, KOMB3) and find governing one. (e) Select side column using iterative approach: start from smallest IPE, check stability interaction (buckling + bending), check deflection, pick smallest passing profile. (f) Select end column similarly (half tributary, same checks). (g) For span>18m select truss chord with buckling check on top chord (Lcr = panel length ~2m). (h) For span<=18m select rafter IPE with moment check. (i) Select purlins (keep existing logic). (j) Return extended CalculationResults with utilization, governing combination/condition, mass/m2, deflection values.

6. Validate: For hall 15m x 50m, h=5m, alpha=15deg, snow zone 2, wind zone 1, S235, terrain II, normal exposure - the calculation should produce IPE 220-240 for side column. For 20m x 60m, h=6m - should produce IPE 240-270.
acceptance_criteria: src/utils/eurocode.ts exists with all specified helper functions exported
src/utils/calculations.ts implements full Eurocode load combinations, frame analysis, stability checks, and deflection checks
src/types/index.ts includes TerrainCategory, SnowExposure, extended HallParameters, extended CalculationResults
src/data/profiles.ts has i_y values for all IPE profiles matching user specification
src/data/loads.ts has corrected wind zone pressures (0.303, 0.423, 0.563)
For 15m span, h=5m, alpha=15, snow 2, wind 1, terrain II, S235: column profile is IPE 220 or IPE 240
For 20m span, h=6m, alpha=15, snow 2, wind 1, terrain II, S235: column profile is IPE 240 or IPE 270
